@@U03560@@
deep down to my heart’s core!
Ridiculous creatures!
Wanting to be gods, they're doomed
to being just what they are!
I could have laid back eons ago
and lived like a god, except that
I felt the need to benefit the best of them.
Ah, but then I saw what they had done,
and it was as if I’d never advised them.

@@U03562@@
True, Old Man of the Sea,
but we trust you all the same.
Youre the sage, after all,
so don't send us packing.
See this flame?
Human enough, I admit,
but ready to follow your every advice
unconditionally.

@@U03564@@
Advice! Ha!
What advice ever counted with men!
Wise words, deaf ears!
Always the same!
They do things,
condemn them afterwards,
and remain as headstrong as ever,
this tribe we call men!
What more could I have done for Paris
than give him a fatherly warning?
But lust had its way,
and so he ensnared the Spartan 海伦.
He stood there boldly on the Grecian shore
as I told him the vision I foresaw:
air full of smoke, torrents of red,
roof beams blazing, death and murder
down below—
translation:
@@U03560@@
深入我的心底！
可笑的生物！
想要成为神，就注定了
成为他们本来的样子！
我本可以在很久以前就放松下来
像神一样生活，除了
我觉得有必要让他们中最好的人受益。
啊，但后来我看到他们做了什么，
就好像我从来没有给过他们建议一样。

@@U03562@@
确实，海洋老人，
但我们仍然相信你。
毕竟你是圣人，
所以不要让我们打包。
看到这火焰了吗？
我承认，足够人性化，
但准备好听从你的每一个建议
无条件地。

@@U03564@@
忠告！哈!
对于男人来说，忠告多么重要啊！
智慧之言，充耳不闻！
总是一样！
他们做事，
事后谴责他们，
并一如既往地任性，
这个部落我们称之为男人！
我还能为巴黎做些什么
而不是给他一个父亲般的警告？
但欲望却有它的方式，
于是他诱捕了斯巴达人海伦。
他勇敢地站在希腊海岸上
正如我告诉他我预见的愿景：
空气中充满烟雾，红色洪流，
屋顶横梁燃烧、死亡和谋杀
下面——
